debugfs 1.47.0 (5-Feb-2023)
[Unit]
Description=YSYX NPC strict rootfs validation and natural poweroff
DefaultDependencies=no
After=ysyx-npc-systemd-autocheck.service
Before=sysinit.target
ConditionPathExists=/usr/local/sbin/ysyx-npc-systemd-strict-check

[Service]
Type=oneshot
StandardInput=null
StandardOutput=tty
StandardError=tty
TTYPath=/dev/ttyS0
TTYReset=no
TTYVHangup=no
TTYVTDisallocate=no
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/ysyx-npc-systemd-strict-check --poweroff
TimeoutStartSec=0

[Install]
WantedBy=sysinit.target
